$comment: Version axes for the ISO 4217 Currency Registry. Declares which files carry which version, how to extract each version, and what each site means. This file is a stable contract — the reference implementation of the axes shape for the QuantOS registries. tools/check_version_consistency.py does not yet read it; the refactor that makes it data-driven waits for ISO 10383's version, making three implementations.
notes: Two independent axes are declared because the data version and the format-contract version can move separately. A patch correction to the data does not change the schema; a new optional field in the schema does not change the data.
Each axis has one source of truth. Every other site on that axis must equal it, or CI fails.
Sites are ordered by reading priority: the source of truth first, then every derived or mirrored site.
An extractor is a named reader. A consumer reads the file at `path` with the extractor's implementation, following the parameters listed in the `extractors` block.

Required sites that are missing fail the check. Optional sites that are missing are skipped, not failed. This lets a registry declare a site that may legitimately be absent from some checkouts (e.g. a Parquet export in an sdist) without weakening the contract for the repo.
The badge extractor matches shields.io badge URLs of the form `https://img.shields.io/badge/<prefix>-X.Y.Z-<color>.svg`. The color is not checked.

text.description: Read the file as UTF-8 text and return its stripped contents. Used for one-line files like VERSION.

first_released_heading.description: Find the first '## [X.Y.Z]' heading in a Markdown file whose trailing text does not start with 'Unreleased'. Trailing text after the version is ignored.

json_path.description: Read the file as JSON and return the value at `json_path`, a dot-separated path with '$' as the root. Only object-key traversal is required.

parquet_footer.description: Read the Parquet file's footer metadata and return the value at `key`, decoded as UTF-8. Uses the file's schema metadata block; the data rows are not read.

badge.description: Match a shields.io badge URL in a Markdown file of the form `badge/<prefix>-X.Y.Z-<color>` and return X.Y.Z. Anchored on `badge/` so it never matches a version mentioned elsewhere in prose.

parameters.prefix: string — the badge's label, e.g. 'registry' or 'schema'

python_regex.description: Apply a Python-flavored regex to the file's text and return the captured group. The default group is 1.

parameters.pattern: string — Python regex, MULTILINE flags applied
parameters.group: integer, optional, default 1 — the capturing group to return

toml_section.description: Read a key from a TOML file, restricted to a named section. Does not match keys in other sections.

parameters.key: string — the key to read, e.g. 'version'

schema_id.description: Read a JSON Schema's `$id` field and extract the trailing '/vX.Y.Z/' segment. The leading 'v' is stripped; the returned value is 'X.Y.Z'.

axes.name: registry
axes.description: The data version. Bumped on a patch for corrections, on a minor for new currencies or new optional data fields. The source of truth is the VERSION file at repo root.

axes.name: schema
axes.description: The format-contract version. Bumped only when the schema's structure changes: a new optional field is a minor bump, a removed or renamed required field is a major bump. The source of truth is schema.json's $id trailing segment.
